title: Pals Rewards Earned-Tier Upgrade Bonus: Amount Posted
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** — the points posted as the earned-tier upgrade bonus when an earned free tier is applied.

**The tier being applied** is the next free tier above the tier the membership holds: Pals Rewards Insider for a Pals Rewards Member, whose qualifying spend threshold is $250.00; Pals Rewards VIP for a Pals Rewards Insider, whose qualifying spend threshold is $750.00.

**The earned-tier upgrade bonus of the tier being applied** is that tier's tier-upgrade bonus: 200 points for Pals Rewards Insider and 500 points for Pals Rewards VIP.

**Posting.** Enrollment bonuses post with the enrollment that earns them, and the earned-tier upgrade bonus posted with an applied earned tier is the sum of the bonus produced by its method and every bonus added to it, as a whole number of points; the bonus produced by its method is the earned-tier upgrade bonus of the tier being applied.

| Tier held | Tier being applied | Threshold of that tier | Earned-tier upgrade bonus of that tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | Pals Rewards Insider | $250.00 | 200 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | Pals Rewards VIP | $750.00 | 500 |

**Examples (hypothetical memberships).**
- A Pals Rewards Member whose spend has earned Pals Rewards Insider: the tier applied is Pals Rewards Insider and the bonus posted with it is 200 points.
- A Pals Rewards Insider whose spend has earned Pals Rewards VIP: the tier applied is Pals Rewards VIP and the bonus posted with it is 500 points.
- A Pals Rewards Member whose spend has passed $750.00: the next free tier above Pals Rewards Member is Pals Rewards Insider, so that is the tier applied, with 200 points.
